housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 1,693.14 for a one-bedroom apartment in Houston city centre. HAR.com, operated by the Houston Association of REALTORS, is the local rental portal. The reviewed Texas State Law Library guidance does not establish a standard deposit in months.

banking.summary: Bank of America requires eligible international professionals to provide foreign and U.S. addresses, primary and secondary identification, and a foreign tax identification number; a U.S. TIN or ITIN is required only if already issued. Chase says non-residents may need government-issued photo identification, proof of U.S. address, and possibly an opening deposit, with exact requirements varying by bank.
required_docs: Government-issued photo identification; Bank of America specifies primary and secondary ID
Foreign tax identification number for Bank of America; U.S. TIN or ITIN if already issued
Possible opening deposit, depending on bank

schools.summary: Houston offers International Baccalaureate and French Baccalaureate curricula at the Awty International School. Houston Independent School District publishes a city schools directory.

legal_admin.summary: CBP creates electronic I-94 arrival/departure records for foreign visitors, who can retrieve the record online when proof of status is needed. After moving, aliens in the United States must report an address change to USCIS within 10 days, except A and G visa holders and Visa Waiver Program visitors.
legal_admin.registration_step: Retrieve the electronic CBP I-94 when proof of admission is needed; after any move, report the new address to USCIS online or with Form AR-11 within 10 days unless exempt.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer eligible for a Social Security number can apply online and then present documents at a Social Security office. A resident or nonresident alien with a federal tax purpose who is not eligible for an SSN applies to the IRS for an ITIN using the ITIN application process, generally with the tax return.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Social Security number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)

transport.summary: Houston METRO operates local bus and METRORail service; the current official fare page lists a USD 1.25 regular local fare and a USD 3 day pass but no monthly pass price. A foreign licence is valid up to one year or until Texas residency, whichever comes first; a new resident must apply for a Texas licence within 90 days. Eligible residents can apply online for Texas health-care benefits through Your Texas Benefits.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: A valid foreign licence may be used for up to one year or until Texas residency, whichever comes first; after becoming a Texas resident, apply for a Texas licence within 90 days.
transport.healthcare_registration: Apply online through Your Texas Benefits for Medicaid or CHIP if eligible; the application asks for identity, citizenship or immigration status, income, property, and expense information.
